info.name: QikBerry Event & Ticketing System API
info.description:
RESTful API for QikBerry's Event & Ticketing System.

Data is split across two databases via Prisma: MySQL for Users and Bookings (ACID-critical), MongoDB for Events and System Logs (flexible schema).

## Before you run anything

1. Set the collection variables `baseURL` (e.g. `http://localhost:4000`) and `version` (`/api/v1`) — they default to a local dev server.
    
2. Run **Auth → Login** or **Auth → Register** first. Both have a test script that captures the returned JWT into the `{{token}}` collection variable automatically.
    
3. Every other request in this collection authenticates via collection-level Bearer auth using `{{token}}` — you don't need to paste a token into individual requests.
    

## Roles to know about

- **Create Event** requires an `ADMIN`\-role token, or it returns 403.
    
- **Book Ticket** requires a `USER`\-role token specifically — an `ADMIN` token returns 401 there.
    
- A default admin is seeded on server startup: `admin@qikberry.com` / `12345678` (see `src/config/db/seed.ts`).

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Logs in and captures the returned JWT into `{{token}}`, used automatically by every other request in this collection.

Swap in the seeded default admin to test admin-only endpoints:
```json
{
  "email": "admin@qikberry.com",
  "password": "12345678"
}
```
Returns 401 for either a wrong email or wrong password — the API deliberately doesn't distinguish which one failed.

Creates a new user with role `USER` and captures the returned JWT into `{{token}}`, same as Login.

Returns 409 if the email is already registered. New accounts can't book right away against events they haven't seen — run **Get All Events** afterward to grab a real `eventId`.

item.description: Registration and login. Both requests run a test script that captures the returned JWT into the `{{token}}` collection variable — run one of these before anything else in this collection.

item.name: Events

request.description:
**Requires an ADMIN-role token.** Log in as `admin@qikberry.com` (see Auth → Login) before running this — a USER-role token gets a 403.

`ticketsRemaining` is not sent in the body; the API seeds it automatically to equal `totalTickets` on creation.

Uses the collection-level `{{token}}` Bearer auth — no hardcoded Authorization header needed here.

Public — no auth required. Paginated list of events, sorted by date ascending.

Supported query params: `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 10, max 100),`search` (optional used to search events based on title) .

Public — no auth required. Fetches a single event by its MongoDB `_id`. Returns 404 if not found.

The id in the URL is just an example — replace it with a real event's `_id` from **Get All Events** or from **Create Event**'s response.

item.description: List and read endpoints are public. Creating an event requires an ADMIN-role token — log in as the seeded admin (see the Auth folder) first.

item.name: User

request.description:
Sets the given user's `role` to `ADMIN`.

Replace the id in the URL with a real user id, e.g. from a **Register** response.

item.description: ⚠️ `PATCH /user/user_role/:id` currently has no auth middleware in the API — this request succeeds unauthenticated regardless of any token sent. Treat it as an admin-bootstrap utility only; it should require an authenticated admin caller before this is used anywhere beyond local development.

item.name: Bookings

request.description: Requires a valid JWT. Returns the caller's own bookings, joined with each event's title, date, and location.

Books `quantity` tickets for `eventId` using an atomic, concurrency-safe decrement against the event's remaining ticket count — safe even if two requests race for the last ticket.

**Requires a USER-role token** — an ADMIN-role token gets a 401 here by design (see `booking.controller.ts`).

Returns 409 if not enough tickets remain, 404 if the event doesn't exist. Replace `eventId` with a real event's `_id` from **Get All Events**.

Cancels `bookingId` and restores its ticket count on the event — but only if the event is more than 48 hours away. Returns 400 if inside that window, 404 if no matching confirmed booking is found for the caller.

Replace `bookingId` with a real booking id from **Book Ticket**'s response or **Get My Tickets**.

item.description: All booking endpoints require a valid JWT via the collection-level `{{token}}` Bearer auth (set automatically by Login/Register). Booking specifically requires a USER-role token — an ADMIN token gets a 401 there.
